set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-view.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Approved September 25 visual design request; no promised 1.0 release dependency. Synthetic examples must preserve failed/untimed/unanchored/external and zero-mass-fill cases.

Remaining / next action: Generate the Forgotten-bag and Silent River synthetic workspace packets through public codecs, with deterministic digests and independent expected view answers; give the exact producer/consumer pair to Atlas.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Plan P1.1: producer-generated synthetic packets matching the v7 canvas boards: (a) 'The forgotten bag' (Main/SourceReading/RevealReturn/Narrow: 10 recall rows incl. one failed and one untimed, 12 events in 3 scenes, tied E02/E07 alternative, one zero-mass fill); (b) 'Silent River' (173 units x 50 scenes incl. untimed and unanchored units, decode-bound and decode-filled origins, external-dominant rows) for FilmScale/TimeVoyage and the Voyage workshop (storyatlas4s docs/delivery/voyage-workshop/data.js gives its producer rules). Written through the public codecs next to WorkspaceFixtures (Bell); decode + validate; digests and expected answers recorded.
Requested by StoryAtlas (storyatlas4s docs/plans/2026-09-25-north-star-plan.md, owner-approved 2026-09-25). Atlas draws only supplied structure (ADR 0002 D4); until this lands Atlas shows an explicit unavailable state.
